title: Negative Purpose and Precautionary Clauses with nehogy

sections.title: How nehogy Works
sections.content: To express taking action in order to prevent an unwanted outcome ('lest', 'for fear that', 'so that ... not'), Hungarian uses the single conjunction nehogy followed immediately by a verb in the subjunctive-imperative mood (-jon/-jen/-jön). Because negation is already built into nehogy, you NEVER add a second ne before the verb: Óvatosan fogalmazott, nehogy félreértsék ('He phrased his words carefully, lest they misunderstand him').

sections.title: nehogy vs. azért, hogy ... ne
sections.content: While azért, hogy ... ne states an objective negative goal ('Azért zártam be az ajtót, hogy ne hallják a próbát'), nehogy carries an emotional charge of caution, anxiety, or urgency—highlighting an undesirable consequence the speaker is actively trying to avert. Notice also word order: in a nehogy clause, the preverb typically stays attached to the subjunctive verb (nehogy elkéssen, nehogy megharagudjon) because nehogy itself occupies the clause-initial operator slot.

sections.title: Precautionary nehogy + Subjunctive Patterns
rows: Suttogva beszéltek, nehogy meghallja őket az őr.
They spoke in whispers lest the guard hear them.
Felírtam a kulcsszavakat, nehogy belesüljek a beszédbe.
I wrote down the keywords so I wouldn't freeze up during the speech.
Hátrébb lépett a rivaldafényből, nehogy elvakítsák a lámpák.
She stepped back from the footlights lest the lamps blind her.
Nehogy eláruld nekik a darab végét!
Don't you dare give away the ending of the play to them!

items.spanish: A szónok gondosan megválasztotta minden szavát, nehogy botrányt robbantson ki.
items.english: The orator carefully chose every word lest he spark a scandal.

items.spanish: Lejegyezte a tanúvallomást, nehogy feledésbe merüljenek a részletek.
items.english: He recorded the testimony lest the details sink into oblivion.

items.spanish: Visszafogta az indulatait, nehogy elveszítse a hallgatóság rokonszenvét.
items.english: She restrained her temper lest she lose the audience's sympathy.

items.spanish: Nehogy azt hidd, hogy ez a vita következmények nélkül marad!
items.english: Don't for a moment think that this debate will remain without consequences!

sections.title: B2 Stylistic Notice
sections.content: Never double-negate after nehogy (`*nehogy ne késsen`), and keep the preverb attached to the verb (`nehogy elbukjon`, NOT `*nehogy bukjon el`).
